title: MisconceptDialogue: Evaluation Criteria Shape Measured Success in LLM Math Tutoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.31679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as math tutors, raising two questions: can a single LLM detect a student's error, diagnose the underlying misconception, and remediate it through multi-turn dialogue - and can we trust the numbers that report how well it does? We address both with MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE, a fully automated framework that runs the full pipeline on five open-weight LLM tutors (7B-14B) interacting with LLM-simulated students over 5,000+ dialogues - a deliberately simulated protocol (paired conditions, a wrong-diagnosis control unsafe with real learners, scale) whose results do not establish real-student learning. On measurement, our headline finding is uncomfortable for the field: benchmark-style exact-match scoring common in standard math NLP - a lower-bound stress test - reports 42.1% measured Remediation Success Rate on identical dialogues where a human-calibrated LLM-as-judge reports 81.3%, a 39.2 percentage-point

translated_title: MisconceptDialogue：评估标准如何塑造LLM数学辅导中测量到的成功
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作数学辅导教师，这引出了两个问题：单一LLM能否检测学生的错误、诊断其背后的误解，并通过多轮对话加以纠正——以及我们能否信任那些报告其表现好坏的数字？我们通过MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE同时回答这两个问题，这是一个完全自动化的框架，在五个开源权重LLM辅导模型（7B-14B）与LLM模拟学生交互的5000多个对话上运行完整流程——这是一个刻意采用的模拟协议（配对条件、对真实学习者不安全的错误诊断对照组、大规模），其结果并不能证明真实学生的学习效果。在测量方面，我们的核心发现对该领域并不乐观：标准数学NLP中常见的基准式精确匹配评分——作为一种下限压力测试——在完全相同的对话上报告的纠正成功率仅为42.1%，而经过人工校准的LLM作为裁判则报告为81.3%，两者相差39.2个百分点
tldr: 该论文提出MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE全自动评估框架，揭示评估标准对LLM数学辅导效果测量结果影响巨大：在相同对话上，精确匹配评分报告的纠正成功率仅为42.1%，而人工校准的LLM裁判评分高达81.3%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE, a fully automated evaluation framework revealing that evaluation criteria drastically shape measured success in LLM math tutoring: on identical dialogues, exact-match scoring reports only 42.1% remediation success while a human-calibrated LLM-as-judge reports 81.3%.
